slices.focus: It has been one of those packed stretches lately where everything blurs together
slices.summary: While killing time at Rosa's house before a soccer match, Marisa puts on Crimson Tide and starts curating a summer rotation of rewatchable 90s action movies as easy social glue for tired teenage evenings.
decisions: Marisa's movie taste shifted further toward keeping rewatchable 1990s action movies in regular summer rotation with Evan
